chapter_title_en: The Heir of Great Karmic Merit
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 372 – A Mere Mortal? Ji Ning Meets Qi Xiaoyu
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning discovers a maidservant with a three-hundred-zhang halo of karmic merit on the Evil Dragon River. The Qi Kingdom remnants are his guests, but the Firewing Legion closes in.
og_title: Desolate Era – The Maidservant of Great Merit
og_description: After drifting on the Evil Dragon River, Ji Ning invites a group of fugitive royalty onto his ship, drawn by a maidservant’s incredible karmic merit. A demon hunting party is approaching.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 372 – Ji Ning’s Disciple Hunt Begins
twitter_description: A chance encounter on a cursed river leads Ji Ning to a potential disciple surrounded by golden merit. But the Firewing Legion is closing in for the kill.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary cursed river in the Star Continent; within 1,000 li, flight and Five Elements escape techniques are suppressed. A classic Xianxia 'forbidden zone' trope that forces all combatants to fight on the ground.
The personal elite guard of the Firewing Demon King. Even its weakest members are at the Wanxiang Adept level, and they are known for hunting down the remnants of the fallen Qi Kingdom.

A tangible, golden light that surrounds a being who has performed great virtuous deeds. It is a sign of favor from the Heavenly Dao and can be seen by high-level cultivators. Qi Xiaoyu's 300-zhang halo is exceptionally vast.
A maidservant and secret disciple of the fallen Qi Kingdom’s imperial clan. She is the target of Ji Ning’s interest due to her immense karmic merit.
The false name used by the eldest prince of the Qi Kingdom. He is a Wanxiang Adept and the leader of the small group of fleeing survivors.
